snippet.title: VOIDRAVE Trailer — Descend Into the Body of a Sleeping God
snippet.description:
VOIDRAVE is an arcade bullet hell in Lovecraftian clothing. A routine sector cleanup mission turns into a descent through the body of a sleeping god. The deeper you go, the more the void notices you.

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4840190

100 waves. 20 hand-crafted pixel bosses with unique attack patterns: lasers, gravity wells, time distortion, and a mirror that throws your own bullets back at you.
Every 10 waves you pick 1 of 3 Mutations. Every run plays differently.
4 ships, an upgrade shop, combat drones, screen-clearing bombs and the limitless VOID OVERCHARGE.
Authentic CRT visuals: scanlines, bloom, chromatic aberration. All of it optional.
Beat wave 100 and unlock ENDLESS MODE. The void does not end.

Stop the heart. Outfly the god. End the dream.
